title: Razorpay Startup Payment Gateway Benefits: Payment Credits, Startup Perks and How to Apply
summary: Explore Razorpay startup benefits, payment credits, eligibility and application steps. Understand offer limits, startup perks and costs after benefits expire.
body_markdown:
Razorpay Startup Perks is a programme that brings payment benefits and selected business tools to eligible funded startups in India. Depending on your funding stage and approved offer, benefits can include domestic and international payment credits, limited-period access to selected products, and help from the startup team.


For a founder watching runway, the useful question is which benefits your business qualifies for, how much you can use before they expire, and what you will pay afterwards. Payment credits are not cash funding, and a product trial does not make every service permanently free.


This guide explains the angel-funded and VC-funded benefit categories, the eligibility checks, and how to apply. It also shows how to compare an approved offer with your expected payment mix, so you can plan launch costs without confusing promotional benefits with ongoing pricing.


## Key Takeaways


- Razorpay Startup Perks offers eligible angel-funded startups up to ₹5 lakh each in domestic and international payment benefits, while the VC-funded tier offers up to ₹30 lakh domestic and ₹20 lakh international, subject to approval and offer terms.
- Zero setup fees and zero AMC reduce fixed gateway costs, but the most cost-effective choice depends on the noncash credits you can use, your payment mix, taxes and charges after the offer ends.
- Apply through the official Startup Perks form or email startups@razorpay.com and confirm your funding eligibility, approved amounts and activation date in writing; payment credits expire when the approved limit is reached or three months after activation, whichever comes first.


## What Are Razorpay Startup Benefits?


Razorpay Startup Perks is an application-based programme for eligible angel-funded and VC-funded startups in India. It groups approved payment benefits with selected business-product offers and programme assistance, subject to funding proof, verification and the applicable terms.


Razorpay offers this programme separately from its standard commercial pricing. Its payment benefits and product offers depend on funding tier, approval and the applicable terms. Ask for the approved benefit amount, its unit, activation date, expiry and the rates that apply after the offer.


The[Startup Perks](https://razorpay.com/m/startup-perks/) organises benefits into five families:


- **Payments:** domestic and international payment benefits applied to an eligible account.
- **Startup banking:** a zero-balance current account offer with a linked GMV benefit on the payment gateway.
- **Payroll:** a limited free period on the payroll product.
- **Corporate card and partner offers:** a collateral-free business credit card application plus SaaS partner benefits.
- **Programme support:** a dedicated manager and support access described on the landing page.


A product appearing in the wider Razorpay ecosystem is not automatically included free in every approved offer. Check the approved product list before assuming coverage.


At launch,[Razorpay Payment Links](https://razorpay.com/payment-links/) can help you collect payments through a link without building a full checkout. Confirm whether the payments and services you need are covered by your approved offer.


### Startup Perks, Standard Gateway Pricing and the 90-Day Offer Are Different


Razorpay Startup Perks is a separate programme for eligible funded startups. It combines approved payment benefits with selected business-product offers. Standard gateway pricing still matters for excluded services and after a benefit ends, so compare the programme with your account’s written commercial terms.


Commercial track Who it is for How it works


Standard[Payment Gateway](https://razorpay.com/payment-gateway/) terms Businesses approved to use the gateway Ordinary commercial terms with zero setup fee and zero annual maintenance charge, plus per-transaction fees by method


[Startup Perks](https://razorpay.com/m/startup-perks/) Eligible angel-funded and VC-funded startups in India Application, funding evidence, verification and approval, with benefits defined in the[Startup Perks terms](https://razorpay.com/m/startup-perks/terms/)


Separate 90-day new-merchant offer Eligible merchants activated on or after 1 July 2026 Its own eligibility, a cumulative domestic transaction-value cap, one redemption per PAN, and GST not waived, per the[90-day offer terms](https://razorpay.com/terms/90-day-free-pg-offer/)


These are distinct tracks. The Startup Perks terms state that offers cannot be combined with other promotional offers unless Razorpay expressly permits it, so do not assume they stack.


## Who Can Apply for Razorpay Startup Perks?


Razorpay Startup Perks is open to businesses registered and operating in India that are angel-funded or VC-funded, can provide satisfactory funding proof, hold a valid and active Razorpay account, and comply with documentation and verification requirements. Approval is discretionary.


### Funding, India Operations and Verification


The[Startup Perks terms](https://razorpay.com/m/startup-perks/terms/) require satisfactory funding proof and completion of the documentation and verification Razorpay determines.


Ask the startup team which funding and business documents it accepts. Do not assume that a startup-recognition certificate alone establishes eligibility.


### What If You Are Bootstrapped or Already Use Razorpay?


Razorpay’s standard Payment Gateway lists zero setup fees and zero annual maintenance charges. Those fixed-fee terms are separate from Startup Perks eligibility. A bootstrapped startup should assess standard pricing and any separately eligible new-merchant offer instead of assuming it qualifies for funded-startup benefits.


If you are unfunded, the practical route is ordinary gateway onboarding plus a check on whether your account qualifies for the separate 90-day offer. The[first 90-day startup payment-cost guide](https://razorpay.com/blog/cost-effective-payment-gateway-startups-india/) covers that offer’s economics in detail.


If you already have a Razorpay account, contact the startup team before applying. The page describes the programme as open to new merchants and also mentions a period of inactivity. Ask the team to confirm your account eligibility; inactivity alone does not establish automatic re-entry.


If you are not formally incorporated, ask which business registrations the programme accepts. Incorporation and registration are different requirements, and the terms still require registration and operations in India.


**Pro-Tip 1:** Prepare your funding evidence and business details before you apply. Ask which documents the team accepts rather than assuming that a startup-recognition certificate alone proves eligibility.


## Angel-Funded vs VC-Funded Startup Benefits


Angel-funded and VC-funded startups have different payment-benefit limits, product-trial periods and partner offers. The table below summarises the benefit categories to discuss with the startup team. Your written approval determines the amount available, its permitted use and the applicable conditions.


Benefit category Angel-funded startup VC-funded startup Conditions to confirm


Domestic payment benefit Up to ₹5 lakh in domestic payment benefits Up to Rs 30 lakh Confirm whether the cap measures eligible payment volume or fee credits; approval and offer terms apply


International payment benefit Up to ₹5 lakh in international payment benefits Up to Rs 20 lakh Separate applicability and international enablement; do not assume domestic coverage transfers


[Magic Checkout](https://razorpay.com/magic-checkout/) Free for 90 days, as listed on the landing page Free for 6 months, as listed on the landing page Product-specific offer; do not apply this duration to payment credits


[Payroll](https://razorpay.com/payroll/) First 3 months free, as listed First 3 months free, as listed Confirm eligible plan, activation and renewal pricing


Startup banking-linked payment benefit Additional Rs 5 lakh GMV with the qualifying zero-balance current-account offer Additional Rs 10 lakh GMV GMV is payment volume, not cash savings; confirm account and benefit approval


Corporate card and partner offers Card application plus up to Rs 20 lakh in SaaS benefits, as listed in terms Card application plus up to Rs 50 lakh in SaaS benefits, as listed in terms Card issuance is subject to credit underwriting and can be declined; not a guaranteed credit limit


Programme assistance Dedicated manager and support, as described on the landing page Same listed category Confirm actual entitlement and channels in your approved offer


Zero setup fees and zero AMC remove fixed gateway overhead; they do not mean all transactions are free. Startup Perks adds conditional benefits for eligible funded businesses. Your payable amount depends on the approved credits, payment methods, taxes and services used.


Do not add the rows into a guaranteed package value. Eligibility, the amount approved and the benefits you can use determine the value to your business. Razorpay may approve a lower amount following risk assessment. Confirm whether each payment-benefit limit refers to eligible payment volume or a fee-credit balance before estimating savings.


**Did You Know 1:** The value of SaaS partner offers is separate from a corporate-card credit limit. Check each offer’s eligibility and redemption terms before treating it as a saving.


## How Do Razorpay Startup Payment Credits Work?


Under the Startup Perks terms, credits are non-monetary, non-transferable value units credited to a user’s account. They may be used solely to offset transaction fees or specific service costs defined in the applicable offer, and they have no independent cash value. They expire at the earlier of the offer limit being reached or three months from offer activation.


### Credits Are Noncash Benefits With Defined Uses


Credits cannot be transferred, exchanged, refunded or encashed. They are account benefits for the uses specified in your approved offer, rather than cash you can withdraw.


Keep payment volume, fee credits and cash savings separate. Ask whether your approved cap measures eligible payment volume or a fee-credit balance before using it in a forecast.


### Limits, Activation and Expiry


Credits are allocated on a first-come basis, and Razorpay may approve less than the headline amount after risk assessment. Their validity ends when the offer limit is reached or three months after offer activation, whichever happens first.


Confirm the offer activation date in writing; do not assume application, signup or the first transaction starts the clock. Product periods differ: Magic Checkout is listed at 90 days for angel-funded startups and six months for VC-funded startups, while payroll is listed at three months.


### Domestic and International Credits Should Be Checked Separately


Check domestic and international benefits separately. Confirm which payment types each benefit covers and whether an unused allowance can move between them. Use the rate card and approved offer for your account when estimating the amount payable.


International payment acceptance needs separate enablement on your account. Confirm activation, supported payment methods and the charges covered by the benefit before budgeting for overseas collections. The[international payment cost guide](https://razorpay.com/blog/international-payment-costs-compared) explains the wider cost considerations.


### A Small Worked Example Without Inflating Savings


Here is a hypothetical unrelated to the published caps. Suppose eligible fees in a period total Rs 2,000 and you hold Rs 1,500 of approved, usable fee credits. Rs 500 of eligible fees remains payable, plus applicable taxes and any charges excluded from the offer.


This hypothetical explains a fee offset. It does not define an actual programme award or assume that credits cover taxes.


**Did You Know 2:** A larger approved allowance is useful only to the extent your startup can redeem it within its validity period. Unused headline value is not the same as money saved.


## How Can Startup Perks Reduce Your Payment Costs?


Razorpay Startup Perks can reduce eligible payment costs for an approved funded startup. Compare the payment-method rates in your offer with the credits you can actually use before expiry. A startup benefit does not automatically remove every platform fee, tax or optional-product charge.


For a useful cost comparison, hold the period, payment mix and eligible volume constant. The lowest-cost choice depends on your approved offer and actual usage.


### Compare What You Will Actually Pay


Your situation What to assess


Funded and eligible Approved usable credits against expected eligible fees during the validity window


Bootstrapped Standard charges, zero setup and zero AMC terms, plus any separately eligible new-merchant offer


International seller Whether international acceptance is enabled, which charges apply and what the benefit covers


Credits expired or exhausted The agreed ongoing rates on your account rate card, plus product renewals


Work through this checklist before you forecast:


- Your expected domestic and international payment mix.
- Expected eligible payment volume inside the validity window.
- Offer activation and expiry dates.
- GST treatment on fees, whether or not credits offset the underlying charge.
- Refund and chargeback policy.
- Optional products that sit outside the approved offer.
- Post-offer pricing by payment method.


Use a single framework: period payment cost = applicable payment fees minus approved credits actually redeemed, plus applicable taxes and charges outside the offer. Do not subtract a payment-volume cap from a rupee fee total, do not count SaaS coupons as gateway-fee savings, and do not assume two offers stack.


### When a Lower Headline Rate Is Not the Whole Decision


Rate is one input. Fixed costs, integration effort, the payment methods your customers actually use, settlement behaviour and pricing after any promotional period all affect what the gateway costs you over a year. A limited-period benefit can improve launch economics without proving permanent lowest cost.


**Pro-Tip 2:** Ask for two forecasts: the period when your approved offer is active and the period after it ends. Use the same expected payment mix in both.


## What Other Startup Perks Can You Explore?


Beyond payment credits, Startup Perks lists business banking, payroll, checkout and partner-tool offers, plus founder programme access. Each has its own eligibility, activation and duration, and each should be assessed against a real operational need.


### Banking, Payroll, Checkout and Partner Tools


Match each offer to a job your team actually has:


- **Business banking:** a zero-balance current account offer to organise collections and payouts. RazorpayX-powered[current accounts](https://razorpay.com/x/current-accounts/) are provided by partner banks. RazorpayX is not a bank.
- **[Payroll](https://razorpay.com/payroll/) :** useful once you have salaried employees and statutory filings to run. The listed free period is three months; confirm the eligible plan and renewal pricing.
- **[Magic Checkout](https://razorpay.com/magic-checkout/) :** relevant if you run an online storefront where checkout friction affects conversion. The listed duration differs by funding tier.
- **Corporate card and SaaS partner offers:** assess card underwriting separately from partner-coupon value.
- **[International Payments](https://razorpay.com/accept-international-payments/) :** only relevant once international acceptance is enabled and approved for your account.


Time-limited offers and separately approved products should be listed in your written offer schedule. If a product is not named there, assume it is charged normally.


### Founder Community and Programme Guidance


The landing page also describes founder community access and expert guidance.[Razorpay Rize](https://razorpay.com/rize/) offers related founder resources and community programmes. Check its entry requirements separately from Startup Perks.


**Did You Know 3:** A product being available in the Razorpay ecosystem does not mean it is included free in every Startup Perks offer. Check the approved product list.


## How to Apply for Razorpay Startup Perks


Apply through the form linked on the official Startup Perks page or by writing to startups@razorpay.com. The landing FAQ states that the team reviews applications and responds within 1-2 business days. That is a stated response expectation, not a guarantee of approval or activation.


Use these steps to prepare your application and confirm the offer before activation.


1. Open the[official Startup Perks page](https://razorpay.com/m/startup-perks/) and review the current offer and the linked terms.
2. Check whether your startup fits the angel-funded or VC-funded category and is registered and operating in India.
3. Prepare business details, funding evidence, Razorpay account information, and the documentation requested for verification. Confirm acceptable evidence with the team rather than guessing.
4. Follow the application form linked from the page. Use the[Startup Perks application form](https://razorpay.typeform.com/to/RpDLEkrM) . You can also contact startups@razorpay.com, as listed on the page.
5. Submit your details and respond to review requests promptly, since allocation is first-come and documentation can be requested again during the term.
6. Obtain the approved benefit schedule in writing before you budget around it.
7. Complete account and product activation and any required verification, then confirm the benefit is actually applied. Track usage against the expiry date.


**What to confirm in writing before activation:**


- Approved domestic and international payment benefit amounts and their units.
- Payment methods and services covered, and those excluded.
- Whether GST remains payable on charges offset by credits.
- Activation date and expiry date for the payment credits.
- Whether unused domestic allowance can move to international, or the reverse.
- Product-specific trial dates for Magic Checkout, payroll and any other products expressly included in your offer.
- Post-offer pricing by payment method.
- Whether any other promotion may be combined with the offer.
- Any verification, KYC or account-related charges that may apply.


**Pro-Tip 3:** Keep the approved offer alongside your first statement. If the benefit you expected is missing, ask the startup team to reconcile the offer and activation before assuming a saving.


Check the current Startup Perks offer and[apply for a review of your startup’s eligibility](https://razorpay.com/m/startup-perks/) .


## What Will You Pay After the Startup Benefits End?


Budget using the payment-method rates agreed for your account. Once a benefit expires or its limit is reached, the applicable charges resume. Confirm GST treatment, international payment charges, and any products outside the offer before forecasting your next quarter.


Payment credits and product trials can end on different dates. Record the approved expiry for each benefit and check renewal charges before the free period ends.


Zero setup fees and zero AMC are separate from variable transaction charges. Check the current[India pricing page](https://razorpay.com/pricing/?preferred-country=IN) and your account rate card for the payment methods you use. Your written commercial terms govern the charges after an offer ends.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### What benefits does Razorpay offer startups?


Razorpay Startup Perks brings together payment benefits and selected offers for eligible funded startups in India. Depending on the approved tier, these can include domestic and international payment benefits, limited-period product offers, and programme assistance. Check the funding criteria and written offer to understand which benefits apply to your business.


### Can bootstrapped startups apply for Razorpay Startup Perks?


The published Startup Perks terms require angel or VC funding, so an unfunded startup should not assume it qualifies. Razorpay’s standard gateway terms and a separately eligible new-merchant offer may still be relevant. Ask the startup team which route fits your business instead of treating every startup offer as the same programme.


### Are Razorpay startup payment credits cash, and when do they expire?


No. The programme terms describe noncash credits with specified uses, not money you can withdraw. They expire when the offer limit is reached or three months after offer activation, whichever happens first. Confirm the approved cap’s unit and coverage, and check product-specific trial periods separately.


### Do Startup Perks make Razorpay the cheapest payment gateway for a startup?


An approved offer can reduce eligible costs, but it does not establish the cheapest gateway for every startup. Compare your expected payment mix, usable credits, offer validity, taxes, excluded services and ongoing rates over the same period.


### How do I apply, and how long does approval take?


Apply through the form linked on the official Startup Perks page or contact startups@razorpay.com. The page states an initial response within 1-2 business days. Approval and activation depend on eligibility, documentation, account verification and the products requested; an initial response is not a guaranteed go-live deadline.
